summary: Tested the Emergent compliance changes (independence notice + visa sample) and ran a light regression, desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844. (1) The exact heading 'We are independent — not the Government of Ghana' shows in apply-independence-notice (the direct sibling right above apply-submit), in payment-independence-notice (under the tracking number, above all payment options) and in success-independence-notice. No overflow, no horizontal page scroll. When centred, elementFromPoint finds no floating button over the heading on mobile. The text is 14px and dark (#0A0A0A) on a light gold background. (2) The visa sample watermark 'SAMPLE / ILLUSTRATION' is visible on desktop and mobile. A DOM text+HTML search on /, /apply, /prices, /faq, /track, /payment and /success found 0 matches for 'Comptroller' and 'Employment Prohibited', and 0 QR/seal/crest elements. A source grep found only the functional USDT deposit-address QR in Payment.jsx (CryptoDepositPanel), which is not part of the visa sample. (3) Full Hubtel flow (desktop UI): form with 4 uploads → payment → sandbox success → success page with the notice → Track shows the app. payment_status was paid. The email log has the customer 'submitted' email, admin_new_submission and admin_payment_success. (4) NOWPayments flow on mobile: the app was created and the USDT TRC20 deposit panel opened. It could NOT be completed by simulation because NOWPayments is in LIVE mode in preview (real api_key set, sandbox=false, simulated=False), so the sim buttons are not shown. A real NOWPayments invoice (payment_id 4910904481) was created; nothing was paid, so it will expire. (5) Regression: tests/test_iteration21_independence_regression.py passed 12/12 (search, date filters, pagination, transactions, CSV/XLSX, tickets, audit-log, health, check now, SMS still disabled, email log). Admin UI: dashboard search, /admin/payments search, CSV and XLSX downloads, lazy pages Tickets/Activity/Monitoring, 'Check now', and the Settings > SMS Alerts tab (checkbox unchecked) all work with no page errors. The old test_iteration15 suite passed 13/15 (1 skipped). Its one failure, test_unsigned_success_callback_marks_paid, is expected in Hubtel SANDBOX mode; iteration16 verified the LIVE-mode protection. Both test apps were deleted (DELETE 200, then GET 404), and a before/after settings snapshot (prices, surcharges, methods, SMS, sandbox flags) is identical.

ui_bugs.issue: Moving from /apply to /payment/{tracking} keeps the old scroll position: scrollY was 1527 on mobile when the payment page opened, and on desktop the notice was at y=-294. So the payment page opens scrolled down at the payment buttons, and payment-independence-notice is off-screen above them. The user can pay without ever seeing it. This weakens the 'clearly visible on the payment page before paying' requirement. On a direct load the notice is in the viewport (top 245px on mobile).

action_items: Add a ScrollToTop on route change (useLocation + window.scrollTo(0,0)) or call window.scrollTo(0,0) in Payment.jsx/Success.jsx on mount, so the independence notice is in view when the payment and success pages open.

Note: NOWPayments is LIVE in preview (real API key, sandbox=false), not in SIMULATION as the brief says. USDT tests from the UI create real invoices. Use the admin sandbox toggle or sandbox keys if simulation is wanted (the testing agent did not change settings).
critical_code_review_comments: IndependenceNotice.jsx is clean and reused in three places with different test ids. Its sub-text is text-xs slate-600 on a gold/15 background; readable, but 12px is small on mobile.
test_iteration15_final_regression.py::test_unsigned_success_callback_marks_paid is out of date for sandbox mode; mark it skipped when hubtel.sandbox=true.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (one medium scroll-position issue; NOWPayments sim flow not reachable because the gateway is live)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted GH-2026-957693 (TEST_Indep Hubtel, paid via Hubtel sandbox) and GH-2026-266547 (TEST_Indep Crypto, unpaid). A live NOWPayments invoice 4910904481 was created with no funds sent. The email log keeps 3 entries for the Hubtel app (test_indep_hubtel@example.com plus the admin addresses).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie banner: set localStorage egv_cookie_consent_v1. Notice test ids: apply-independence-notice, payment-independence-notice, success-independence-notice. Watermark: visa-sample-watermark. Run pytest with -n 0 or the default xdist. Do NOT run test_iteration14 (it writes SMS settings). NOWPayments is LIVE: crypto-sim-* buttons only appear when simulated. To check the success page on mobile without crypto, use a Hubtel-sandbox-paid app.
